mapper.select: SELECT rt.id AS roomTypeId, rt.type_name AS roomTypeName, COUNT(DISTINCT bo.id) AS orderCount, SUM(bo.total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM booking_order bo JOIN room_type rt ON bo.room_type_id = rt.id WHERE bo.status = 4 AND bo.check_in_date >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND bo.check_in_date < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY rt.id, rt.type_name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room WHERE room_type_id = #{roomTypeId}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.check_in_time IS NULL OR ci.check_out_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(LEAST(DATE(ci.check_out_time), DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE})), GREATEST(DATE(ci.check_in_time), DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}))) + 1 END), 0) AS occupancyDays FROM check_in_record ci JOIN room r ON ci.room_id = r.id WHERE r.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND ci.check_in_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (ci.check_out_time IS NULL OR ci.check_out_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}))

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS roomFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS depositFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS otherFee FROM income_record WHERE payment_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND payment_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date` ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS `date`, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS refundFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS purchaseFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS salaryFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 3 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS utilityFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 4 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS otherFee FROM expense_record WHERE create_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND create_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `date` ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') AS `date`, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS refundFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS purchaseFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS salaryFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 3 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS utilityFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 4 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS otherFee FROM expense_record WHERE create_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND create_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') ORDER BY `date` ASC

WITH RECURSIVE periods AS ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS period_date WHERE DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) <= DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(period_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM periods WHERE DATE_ADD(period_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) <= DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) ), income_data AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y-%m') AS period_key, SUM(amount) AS total_income FROM income_record WHERE payment_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND payment_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y-%m') ), expense_data AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS period_key, SUM(amount) AS total_expense FROM expense_record WHERE create_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND create_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ) SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(cte_max_recursion_depth=100000) */ DATE_FORMAT(p.period_date, '%Y-%m') AS `date`, IFNULL(i.total_income, 0) AS income, IFNULL(e.total_expense, 0) AS expense FROM periods p LEFT JOIN income_data i ON i.period_key = DATE_FORMAT(p.period_date, '%Y-%m') LEFT JOIN expense_data e ON e.period_key = DATE_FORMAT(p.period_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY p.period_date ASC

WITH RECURSIVE periods AS ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}), '%Y-01-01') AS DATE) AS period_date WHERE DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) <= DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(period_date, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) FROM periods WHERE DATE_ADD(period_date, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) <= DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) ), income_data AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y') AS period_key, SUM(amount) AS total_income FROM income_record WHERE payment_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND payment_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, '%Y') ), expense_data AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') AS period_key, SUM(amount) AS total_expense FROM expense_record WHERE create_time >= DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND create_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') ) SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(cte_max_recursion_depth=100000) */ DATE_FORMAT(p.period_date, '%Y') AS `date`, IFNULL(i.total_income, 0) AS income, IFNULL(e.total_expense, 0) AS expense FROM periods p LEFT JOIN income_data i ON i.period_key = DATE_FORMAT(p.period_date, '%Y') LEFT JOIN expense_data e ON e.period_key = DATE_FORMAT(p.period_date, '%Y') ORDER BY p.period_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room WHERE status != 0

WITH RECURSIVE day_dates AS ( SELECT DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AS full_date WHERE DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) <= DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(full_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM day_dates WHERE full_date < DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) ) SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(cte_max_recursion_depth=100000) */ DATE_FORMAT(dd.full_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT room_id) FROM check_in_record WHERE check_in_time < DATE_ADD(dd.full_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (check_out_time IS NULL OR check_out_time >= DATE_ADD(dd.full_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY))) AS occupiedRooms FROM day_dates dd ORDER BY dd.full_date ASC
